Read the workspace's root output values from its state — `tofu output -json`: the values the last apply recorded. A sensitive output prints as '\_\_cty_sensitive\_\_' unless show_sensitive.

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** read · plan · apply · full

## Annotations

| Annotation | Value |
|---|---|
| `readOnlyHint` | true |
| `destructiveHint` | false |
| `idempotentHint` | false |
| `openWorldHint` | true |

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_alias` | string | no | Workspace alias, as 'open' named it. Omit for the workspace opened without an alias ('default'), however many others are open. |
| `name` | string | no | One output's name (default: every output). |
| `show_sensitive` | boolean | no | Print a sensitive output's value instead of '\_\_cty_sensitive\_\_' (default false). Only when you need the secret: it enters the conversation. |
